heading.title: Keys and dependencies

heading.title: Normalisation and useful duplication
heading.brief: Separate facts with independent lifetimes; preserve unit_price as the agreement rather than a copy of today’s catalogue price.

nested_article.title: History, correction and deletion
nested_article.brief: Represent agreements, corrections and deletion without confusing today’s state with history.
outcomes: Distinguish effective time from recorded time
Trace a correction or deletion through dependent and external records

heading.title: Documents within rows
heading.brief: Contrast variable product attributes with independent related facts; introduce JSON choices without making normalisation a ban on documents.

nested_article.title: PostgreSQL JSON and structured alternatives
nested_article.brief: Use PostgreSQL JSONB where it fits the facts, validation and update boundary.
